english.title: Possess live / dead Schedule 1 wild bird or its parts
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), had in your possession or control

(A)_[a live wild bird]_
(B)_[a dead wild bird]_
(C)_[live wild birds]_
(D)_[dead wild birds]_
(E)_[part or parts of or anything derived from a wild bird]_
(F)_[parts of or anything derived from wild birds]_

included in Schedule 1 to the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SPECIES OF BIRD(S)..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1(2)(a) and 21(1) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Where one or more bird is involved in a single offence the maximum fine shall be determined as if the person convicted had been convicted of a separate offence in respect of each bird (Section 21(5)).
